title: Perverse generic extension on a normal excellent scheme
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and $X$ a Noetherian excellent normal integral scheme with $\ell$ invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $\eta$ be its generic point, $j:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)\to X$ its inclusion, and $\delta$ a dimension function with $\delta(\eta)=0$ [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex, def-weil-residue-field]. Put $\varphi(x)=\max(0,-2\delta(x)-2)$. Use ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The perverse t-structure for $\varphi$ on $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ is the one whose upper class is specified by $H^a(M|_x)=0$ for $a>\varphi(x)$ and whose lower class is specified by $H^a(R\Gamma_xM)=0$ for $a<\varphi(x)$, for every point $x$. Write $\tau^{\varphi}_{\leq0}$ for its upper truncation. The object
$$T=\tau^{\varphi}_{\leq0}Rj_*\Lambda$$
has canonical pinnings making it potential for $(X,\delta,\Lambda)$, with identity pinning at $\eta$. Every pinned potential $K$ for these data admits a unique pinning-preserving isomorphism to $T$, induced by its generic pinning and perverse adjunction. Moreover the scalar map
$$\Lambda_X\longrightarrow\tau_{\leq0}R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(K,K)$$
is an isomorphism, where $\tau_{\leq0}$ is ordinary cohomological truncation and $R\mathcal Hom$ is derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].
